newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 steady on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 steady on good demand.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were steady in late trading on Wednesday following fresh enquiries in Medan and Palembang, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.00-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.75-55.00 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 54.25-54.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
They said they expected to secure deals later today following fresh enquiries for SIR20 fob Palembang and fob Medan from firms in Singapore and the United States.
February SIR20 was last bought at 54.50 fob Medan and April SIR20 also fob Medan at 55.00 late on Tuesday.
